name: cache-memory-ceiling
title: dsh-find-ideas: bound the in-process cache with LRU eviction
description: The module-level Map in src/cache.ts grows for the whole process lifetime. Add MAX_MEMORY_ENTRIES=64 with hit-refresh LRU, delete expired entries on read, and expose cacheMemoryStats() so the ceiling is assertable.
creator: Tianyao2003
